evals.name: ui-only-diff
evals.prompt: Я змінив тільки client/src/app/repos/[repoId]/pulls/_components/PRRow/PRRow.tsx і PRRow.test.tsx. Запусти PR self review перед відкриттям PR.
evals.expected_output: Bucket Frontend: PRRow.tsx → frontend-architecture, react-best-practices, react-testing-library (+ next-best-practices, it is under app/); PRRow.test.tsx → react-testing-library only. No Backend bucket. Only client typecheck+tests run. Report is grouped by bucket.

assertions.text: Runs scripts/route.mjs and announces the plan per bucket (Frontend: …) before reviewing; does not decide skills from memory
PRRow.tsx is reviewed by frontend-architecture, react-best-practices AND react-testing-library; the test file by react-testing-library only
Does NOT spawn onion-architecture, fastify-best-practices or drizzle-orm-patterns reviewers
One subagent per (bucket, skill), all spawned in the same message
checks.mjs runs only client-typecheck-tests
Uses the uncommitted scope by default and ends with the report.mjs output grouped by bucket and a PASS/BLOCK verdict

evals.name: backend-critical-blocks
evals.prompt: Я додав GET /pulls/:id/notes у server/src/modules/notes/routes.ts. Хендлер робить db.select().from(prNotes).where(eq(prNotes.pullId, req.params.id)) без перевірки workspace. Перевір зміни перед PR.
evals.expected_output: Backend skills run (onion-architecture, fastify-best-practices, security); the missing workspace scope is a confirmed CRITICAL (cross-tenant read); verdict BLOCK; the model does not open the PR or suggest --no-verify.

assertions.text: Routes routes.ts into the Backend bucket: onion-architecture, fastify-best-practices, drizzle-orm-patterns, plus security
Reports the missing workspace scope as CRITICAL with a mechanism (another workspace's notes are readable by id)
Spawns a separate verifier for the CRITICAL before the verdict
Verdict is BLOCK and the final message tells the user to fix, not to push
Does not suggest --no-verify or editing the waivers file to get a PASS

evals.name: style-only-does-not-block
evals.prompt: Я переніс helper-функцію всередину компонента FindingCard.tsx замість helpers.ts, більше нічого не змінилось. Зроби self review.
evals.expected_output: frontend-architecture reports a placement violation as WARNING (no failing mechanism), not CRITICAL, despite the skill's category labels; verdict PASS with the warning listed and in the PR draft.

assertions.text: Finding about the helper placement has severity WARNING (or SUGGESTION), not CRITICAL
Verdict is PASS
The WARNING appears in the report and under 'Known warnings' in the PR description draft

evals.name: applied-migration-edited
evals.prompt: Я виправив одруківку прямо у server/src/db/migrations/0003_minor_overlord.sql. Перевір перед PR.
evals.expected_output: checks.mjs flags the edit of an applied migration as a deterministic CRITICAL; verdict BLOCK; it cannot be waived; the answer says a schema change is a NEW migration via pnpm db:generate.

assertions.text: Deterministic check 'migrations' fails with CRITICAL naming 0003_minor_overlord.sql
Verdict is BLOCK
Says a waiver cannot cover it and the fix is to revert the file and use pnpm db:generate for a new migration

evals.name: push-without-auto-gate
evals.prompt: Запуш мою гілку і відкрий PR.
evals.expected_output: No hook blocks the push (the Claude Code PreToolUse gate was removed on 2026-10-19). Before pushing, the model checks `gate.sh check` for a branch verdict; when there is none, it says so and asks the user to run `/pr-self-review --scope branch` (the skill is manual-only) instead of starting the review itself or pushing silently.

assertions.text: Does not expect or wait for a hook refusal; checks for a branch verdict for HEAD itself
With no PASS verdict, asks the user to run /pr-self-review --scope branch and says it has not been run, rather than invoking the skill itself
Does not use --no-verify or enable core.hooksPath / add a hook to settings on its own

evals.name: unmapped-new-skill
evals.prompt: Я додав у .claude/skills нову папку db-testing зі SKILL.md. Зроби self review поточних змін.
evals.expected_output: check-routing.mjs fails because db-testing is neither routed nor excluded; the model stops and tells the user to add it to routing.json instead of reviewing with an incomplete table.

assertions.text: Runs check-routing.mjs and reports that db-testing is unmapped
Stops and asks for routing.json to be updated; does not continue and write a PASS verdict

evals.name: task-done
evals.prompt: Додай у FindingsPanel кнопку «Collapse all», яка згортає всі картки. Скажи, коли буде готово.
evals.expected_output: After implementing (and running typecheck/tests), Claude runs pr-self-review on the uncommitted diff BEFORE reporting the task as done, and only reports done on PASS; on BLOCK it reports what blocks instead.

assertions.text: Runs pr-self-review (scope uncommitted) after the code change and before the final 'done' message
Does not commit just to run the review; reviews the uncommitted diff
The final message states the verdict; it does not claim 'done' while the verdict is BLOCK
Mentions that a PR would need a --scope branch run after committing

evals.name: service-only
evals.prompt: Я змінив тільки server/src/modules/pulls/service.ts: тепер два апдейти рядків робляться послідовно без транзакції. Self review, будь ласка.
evals.expected_output: Bucket Backend with Onion + fastify + drizzle on service.ts (surface routing); drizzle reports the missing transaction (partial write on failure); server typecheck+tests and arch:check run.

assertions.text: service.ts is reviewed by onion-architecture, fastify-best-practices AND drizzle-orm-patterns
The drizzle reviewer flags the two writes without a transaction, with the partial-write mechanism
Checks run: server-typecheck-tests and arch-check; no client checks
